integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo standard facts on flag/Grassmannian geometry, ordinary double points, normal Gorenstein complete intersections, and small crepant resolutions; the anticanonical line-bundle formula is sourced to arXiv:2003.12286v1. Exact symbolic computations are bundled and replayable.
scientific_limitations: Specific to regular semisimple S in dimension four and h=(3,3,4,4); no classification for other weak-Fano Hessenberg functions is claimed. Literature searches cannot exclude an uncatalogued equivalent formulation.
title: The anticanonical model of the weak-Fano Hessenberg fourfold with \(h=(3,3,4,4)\)
